facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; bring export earnings home within nine months of the invoice date.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: an EEFC account keeps 100% of your foreign earnings in currency.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Razorpay accepts unregistered individuals with a personal bank account, PAN and Aadhaar.
facts.L1_registration: No separate registration needed; free Udyam (MSME) registration is optional.
facts.L2_tax_id: PAN; get a free instant e-PAN online with Aadhaar.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Residents pay tax on worldwide income; professionals can use a simplified presumptive scheme.
facts.L4_vat_gst: GST: exports are zero-rated; no registration needed below ₹20 lakh turnover.
facts.L5_data_protection: DPDP Act 2023 applies; its rules phase in over 18 months from November 2025.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Selling from your own site? Appoint a grievance officer and acknowledge complaints within 48 hours.
facts.L7_incentives: No GST on exports, a foreign-currency EEFC account, and simplified presumptive tax.
facts.D1_id_document: Aadhaar, plus your PAN card for payment platforms.

watch_out.text: Bring export earnings home within nine months; the rule changed in September 2026.
